scope: minimal deterministic demonstration-selection repair for rights-blocked NarrativeQA and Multi-LexSum loaders

changes: NarrativeQA training demonstration shuffle receives seed=seed
Multi-LexSum training-summary demonstration shuffle receives seed=seed
patch.allowed_semantic_change: demonstration identity becomes an explicit deterministic function of the existing loader seed

decision.pass: the exact patch applies; upstream has two unseeded target shuffles and patched source has zero; independent processes with different PYTHONHASHSEED values produce identical full prompts at seed 42; seed 43 changes the demonstration/prompt identity
decision.authority: qualifies the two-line prompt-determinism repair on synthetic fixtures
decision.manifest_rule: a new HELMET evaluation-manifest version must pin this patch before either loader can be used

non_claims: fixture determinism establishes real-dataset prompt identity
the patch resolves dataset rights, tokenizer identity, model-judge reproducibility, or contamination
a source patch may be applied to the current frozen manifest without a successor version
